svg.title: Equal-sized orders can differ in the timing of their fills
svg.desc: Schedule A trades 2500 shares at slots 1, 2, 5, 6; schedule B at slots 1, 3, 4, 6. Both trade 10000 shares within six slots. The lower panel shows analytical residual impact fractions z to the power k for assumed retention factors 0.25 and 0.75.
